node.statement: The scale inequalities W.K2>=max{1,W.L,W.c0_cb*W.L} imply epsilon<=t_2, epsilon_U,epsilon_R<=W.L*epsilon<=t_2, d_U<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_U<=W.c0_cb*W.L*epsilon<=t_2, and ||v_U(I)-u_{A_U}||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_U<=t_2. They also imply W.c0_cb*epsilon<=t_2, so the incoming extended W.c0_cb*epsilon-inclusion is, by monotonicity of the defining defect and norm inequalities, an extended t_2-inclusion; no unitality is asserted or needed.
